name: Steady Pullrope
description: Judge the timber of a great beam by its ring and grain so the engine will bear the strain of the heaviest shot.

name: Vigilant Pullrope
description: Form the crew in two ranks facing across the engine so each rank has one half of the winch to work.

name: Tackleinsight
description: Raise the azure banner at the engine's head to tell the whole line the beam is wound and ready.

name: Beneficent Fulcrum
description: Soak the great sling in water before use so its cords swell tight and take the heavy load without slip.

name: Daybreak Longarm
description: Roll the massive shot into the cradle on greased rails with a team on each side of the load.

name: Might Releasehook
description: Run qi through the winch crew by a call and answer so the great beam descends in one smooth motion.

name: Gnashing Tackle
description: Loose the massive shot at the crest of the swing so it leaves in a high slow arc that few can dodge.

name: Shattering Overthrow
description: Release the two ranks' pins a breath apart so the shot leaves clean with no twist from uneven pulls.

name: Daybreak Hangcradle
description: Drive qi into the massive shot so its fall crushes a broad patch of ground and scatters all upon it.

name: Glint Slingpouch
description: Put the whole crew's qi through the great arm so the shot breaks a defensive ward as if it were glass.

name: Iron Shortarm
description: Gather every crewman's qi into one long winding then loose a single stone that falls on one chosen spot.

name: Daybreak Pullrope
description: Tie a signal cord between two engine beams so the pull of one is felt in the other.

name: Energizing Slingpouch
description: Take the level of both axles with a single water-trough rule laid between the engines.

name: Might Ballast
description: Station the two crews as mirror images so each crewman has a partner across the gap.

name: Beneficent Rigging
description: Match the two shots in weight on the scale to the last grain so their flights are alike.

name: Equipoise Shortarm
description: Call the winding count so the second crew's answer echoes the first with the same cadence.

name: Pulleyrespite
description: Feel through the tied cord when the sister beam reaches its notch and wind your own to meet it.

name: Vengeful Letgo
description: Loose both pins when the cord goes slack so the shots leave at the same instant.

name: Shattering Swing
description: Throw one shot low and one high from the paired engines so both arrive within a breath of each other.

name: Unsparing Tackle
description: Send the paired shots on lines that cross over the target so they strike from either quarter.

name: Dismantling Rigging
description: Bracket a position with the two engines so one shot falls short and one long and the third is certain.

name: Healing Fulcrum
description: Join the two crews' qi by the tied cord so both beams swing with the strength of the stronger crew.

name: Novatackle
description: Time both engines through the tied cord so two shots strike one point in the same instant and break any ward.

name: Galvanizing Fulcrum
description: Roll the shot along a log road laid on the river bank to the engine cradle.

name: Verity Longarm
description: Float a stick on the river to read the current's speed and mark how fast a boat will drift past.

name: Pulleyinsight
description: Choose a shot of cast iron over stone when the target is a vessel or a sealed door.

name: Swing Reckoning
description: Aim ahead of a river craft by the distance the current will carry it before the shot arrives.

name: Novaarm
description: Loose the shot low so it strikes the water and skips into the side of a passing hull.

name: Booming Overthrow
description: Fill the ford with falling shot so a crossing force breaks and turns back.

name: Swingruin
description: Put qi into an iron shot so it drives through a hull and the ward on its deck.

name: Suffocating Counterswing
description: Lay stone fall along both banks so a river crossing stays closed for as long as the engines keep casting.

name: Downpour Whiplash
description: Gather qi through a long winding then drop one great iron shot that breaks the whole crossing under it.

name: Clairvoyant Hangcradle
description: Dye the shot and the sling the grey of high cloud so it is lost against the sky as it climbs.

name: Releasehook Premonition
description: Train the eyes to judge a far target by hawk-sight and mark it on a drawn card.

name: Vitalpulley
description: Oil the pin until it slips without the metal click that warns the enemy of a throw.

name: Vigilant Rigging
description: Wait in the dawn mist beside the engine until the target camp stirs and the air is still.

name: Radiant Releasehook
description: Wrap the winch gears in leather so winding makes no sound a sentry could track.

name: Brutalizing Heaveoff
description: Throw high into the dusk so the stone arrives unseen against the dark of the sky.

name: Rumbletackle
description: Loose the shot with no click or crack so the first warning is the stone's fall.

name: Eviscerating Whiplash
description: Loose in the first light as the sentries blink so the shot falls where they have only just stood.

name: Chime Tackle
description: Lob the stone up into the cloud base so it falls from a height no watcher thinks to scan.

name: Swingscourge
description: Drop a stone onto a command post through its ward before its officers know the engine has fired.

name: Reverie Letgo
description: Veil the engine and its throw in dust and cloud shadow so the enemy cannot trace where the stone came from.

name: Counterswing Glimmer
description: Shift the whole crew and its gear to a prepared second site at once after firing so the reply lands on empty ground.

name: Iron Heaveoff
description: Gather qi in silence through a long winding then loose a stone that no sentry sees until it strikes a chosen post.

name: Armrespite
description: Marshal the wagons of beams and shot along the basin road in the order they will be assembled.

name: Shortarm Vigil
description: Grease every wagon axle before a haul so the train does not stall on the long basin road.

name: Resurgent Longarm
description: Cut a count mark into each beam section so the crews can rebuild the engine in order in the dark.

name: Equipoise Pullrope
description: Peg out the engine yard in lines before the wagons arrive so each engine has its place ready.

name: Intentpulley
description: Assemble the engine from its sections in one drilled sequence with each crew hammering its own joint on the beat.

name: Eviscerating Fulcrum
description: Make the first shot from a newly raised engine soon after its last pin is set to test the range.

name: Intent Rigging
description: Swap a cracked beam arm for a spare in a single practiced heave while the other engines keep firing.

name: Unsparing Ballast
description: Open a siege with every engine of the train loosing as one so the first fall covers the enemy front.

name: Intent Overthrow
description: Hold a measured fall of shot across a besieged place for days so its defenders cannot rest or repair.

name: Dismantling Letgo
description: Gather qi across all the engines of the train and loose the battery in one drawn moment to break a stretch of rampart.

name: Verity Hangcradle
description: Mark the enemy engine's position by the glint of its beam against the skyline and the dust of its fall.

name: Sharp Ballast
description: Take the bearing of an incoming shot from its crater and trace the line back to the enemy position.

name: Arminsight
description: Set a pole to mark the last enemy fall so every crew sees what bearing to answer.

name: Intent Slingpouch
description: Post a lookout on each flank to track enemy engines and report to one captain by the same sign.

name: Chime Longarm
description: Measure the depth and spread of a crater with a rod to guess the weight of the shot that made it.

name: Whiplash Devastation
description: Lay the engine on a fresh bearing from the spotter's call and loose in the first moments after a hit.

name: Facet Pullrope
description: Send two engines against the same enemy site on two tracks so the second corrects the first.

name: Might Slingpouch
description: Scatter the crew from the engine at the whistle of an incoming shot and return to the winch as it lands.

name: Berserk Fulcrum
description: Drive qi into the answering shot so it breaks the enemy engine's frame and crew ward together.

name: Tackle Valor
description: Leave one engine wound and silent until the enemy reveals itself then throw at once on the preset bearing.

name: Punishing Glint Shortarm
description: Seek the foe's engine by its fall and send a single stone back along the same line to strike the machine itself.

name: Healing Releasehook
description: Bed the sill on bare plateau rock with wedges cut into the stone so no gust or throw can walk the engine.

name: Might Hangcradle
description: Run guy ropes from the frame to iron pins in the plateau rock so a gale cannot overturn the engine.

name: Equipoise Releasehook
description: Swear each crewman to a fixed station and hold it through the throw whatever the wind brings.

name: Energizing Rigging
description: Pile a small cairn on each line of fire so any crew can find the bearing again by feel.

name: Waning Shortarm
description: Hang a light feather from the frame to read the faintest shift of the wind across the plateau.

name: Blazeswing
description: Throw with the gale at the back so the stone carries far beyond the engine's calm range.

name: Tacklehavoc
description: Set the aim upwind of the bearing cairn so the cross gust carries the stone to the mark.

name: Tackleruin
description: Wait through a gust for the instant the plateau wind falls still and loose in that breath.

name: Vital Ballast
description: Wind the beam in a hush with every crewman bound to one breath so no gust finds a loose hand.

name: Daybreak Overthrow
description: Rain stones off the plateau edge in a driven storm that sweeps the slope below.

name: Pulleywrath
description: Cast with the wind sworn at the back and qi in the shot so the stone breaks through a guard.

name: Novaletgo
description: Gather the crew's oath and qi into one long winding and loose a stone that rides the whole gale onto the mark.

name: Tacklerespite
description: Speak the oath along the battery from engine to engine so each crew binds itself to the next.

name: Tacklevigil
description: Drive a line of stakes on the bearing so every engine in the battery aims along the same line.

name: Buoying Tackle
description: Raise a thin smoke on the bearing stake to tell the far engines that the line is set.

name: Intentarm
description: Ring the engine's base with stones so any shift of the sill shows against the ring at a glance.

name: Unsparing Releasehook
description: Loose each engine on the oath count in turn so the battery fires as one voice.

name: Letgoscourge
description: Walk the fall along the held bearing a step at a time without turning the engine off its line.

name: Equipoise Rigging
description: Steady all engines through a gust by a shared oath and qi so no beam slips off its bearing.

name: Charter Swing
description: Rake a held bearing with a continuous fall of stone so nothing can cross the line.

name: Siltarm
description: Bind the whole battery by oath and qi into a single volley that falls in a closed patch.

name: Grievous Tackle
description: Hold the bearing through a long winding of the whole battery and loose one stone that cannot be turned aside.

name: Energizing Longarm
description: Spread the engines widely over open ground so no one shot of the enemy can reach two of them.

name: Prescient Ballast
description: Post watchers on high ground to track the enemy's approach across the empty plain.

name: Radiant Pullrope
description: Pack the engine gear in an order that lets the crew take down and move the machine in minutes.

name: Hoarfrost Letgo
description: Loose the first shot before the enemy's skirmishers close the open ground.

name: Armwrath
description: Throw and then drag the engine back one step along the bearing to keep the foe at long range.

name: Swing Flash
description: Spread the crew in a thin ring around the engine so a single enemy stone cannot hit more than one.

name: Dismantling Counterswing
description: Cast a mixed load over an advancing skirmish line so it scatters before reaching the engine.

name: Tempered Fulcrum
description: Put qi through the throw to break a champion's ward on the open field before he reaches the engine.

name: Merciless Rumble Counterswing
description: Gather every hand's qi into one throw when the line is lost and loose a stone that stops the charge.

name: Intent Longarm
description: Lengthen the throwing arm by lashing an ashwood extension to its tip for a longer sweep.

name: Unerring Hangcradle
description: Double the sling cords with wind-waxed twine so they hold the strain of a far throw.

name: Buoying Fulcrum
description: Reckon the far distance by the apparent height of a known landmark standing on the horizon.

name: Unerring Releasehook
description: Weigh the shot against the strength of the high wind and choose the heavier for far carry.

name: Revitalizing Pullrope
description: Rotate the crew through the long pull in shifts so the last winding is as strong as the first.

name: Glint Overthrow
description: Free the sling at the last moment of the arm's rise to give the greatest reach.

name: Glintletgo
description: Shift the bearing by the reckoned drift so the far stone lands where the wind would take it.

name: Unsparing Overthrow
description: Lift the stone into the high gale so its wind carries it farther than any calm throw.

name: Grievous Letgo
description: Correct the second far throw from a rider's report of where the first fell.

name: Hellish Slingpouch
description: Put qi into the far stone so it keeps its force over great distance and still breaks the ward at the end.

name: Blazearm
description: Spread a far throw into a hail that falls over a long wide strip of the enemy rear.

name: Charter Whiplash
description: Keep a far barrage on the enemy rear so reserves cannot gather to support the front.

name: Glint Tackle
description: Gather qi through a long winding and loose a far stone that strikes a mark no one at the engine can see.

name: Ballast Respite
description: Knot an oath into the sling cord with each crewman tying one turn so the cord is bound to the crew.

name: Prescient Pullrope
description: Weight the pouch with a stitched flap so a gale cannot flap it open before the release.

name: Pulleyvigil
description: Cut a mark on the plateau rock where the sling should be free so crews repeat the same release.

name: Veritytackle
description: Watch the pouch through the swing and note the fraction of a breath it opens late or early.

name: Buoying Slingpouch
description: Lengthen or shorten the sling against the wind strength by a hand's breadth.

name: Gust Heaveoff
description: Let the oath cord slip free at its sworn moment so the shot leaves with no flutter.

name: Overthrow Havoc
description: Whip the sling around the arm at the plateau edge so the stone spins out over the drop.

name: Blazeletgo
description: Loose low so the stone skims the plateau rock and bounds into the enemy in the open.

name: Berserk Shortarm
description: Fill the cord and shot with qi on the oath word so the stone strikes through the foe's ward.

name: Granite Shortarm
description: Whirl a mixed load from the sling so a gale of gravel and stone flies out over the slope.

name: Ironpulley
description: Bind the crew's oath into the sling and loose it in one throw that finds its mark despite the gale.

name: Armvigil
description: Take the bearing of an incoming stone from its first rising shape against the sky.

name: Verityarm
description: Read the fall of an enemy stone through the gale and predict where the next will land.

name: Energizing Hangcradle
description: Sound a short whistle at an incoming shot so every crewman knows to scatter.

name: Equipoise Longarm
description: Drill the crew to return to the winch within a few breaths of a landing so the engine is never idle.

name: Glint Heaveoff
description: Lay the answering stone by the wind-drift reading of the enemy's last fall.

name: Facet Rigging
description: Use the wind that carried the enemy's shot to carry the reply faster back along its path.

name: Pulleyflash
description: Scatter the crew along the plateau in a pattern that the enemy's last bearing does not fit.

name: Tempered Letgo
description: Strike an enemy engine through its ward with a stone driven by qi on the bearing of its own fall.

name: Gusttackle
description: Shape qi before the engine to turn an incoming stone aside along the wind so the frame stands.

name: Eviscerating Counterswing Wrath
description: Hold still through the enemy's volley then answer with one long-wound stone that breaks their engine.
